lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaCd crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms—two Na and two Cd—distributed across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies both Cd and Na centers as having 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with Cd surrounded by 10 Na and 2 Cd neighbors, and Na by 10 Cd and 2 Na neighbors, at distances from 2.8884 to 3.4191 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Cd–Na and Na–Na 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing edges and faces, while Cd–Cd polyhedra share corners and edges.
